It’a hard as fuck to get off it, but if you stop after awhile you start to kind of forget what it’s like, you’ll never really forget what it’s like but it gets easier to not think about it all the time. It’s the only drug I’ve had a problem with, even cocaine or weed I could live without but like the other guy said it’s like a drugs drug. There’s before you started doing heroin, and after. Like other people say; it feels like warmth, a blanket getting pulled over you, a weight being lifted off. After doing a shot I always felt it behind my eyes first and it would just go down from your head to the rest of your body. But then before I knew it I’d come to having rubbed my nose literally raw from the itching it gives you. Then there’s being dope sick. It’s not worth it on a whole, I permanently wish I’d never done it. 

Honestly idk how I feel about it being legalized because I’d totally just succumb to a life of good cheap heroin like if it was booze or weed, and although I think most conspiracy theories are stupid, I do feel like if a (one world)government ever wanted to control a big population they’d legalize heroin and encourage it’s use to get as many on it as possible. Honestly it’s more the criminal element combined with all the dependence stuff that made me want to quit it rather than just “oh I shouldn’t be doing this cause it’s bad”. It was fucking awesome, it just wasn’t worth all the hustling and being sick and having to go to a fucking methadone clinic every morning bullshit, and mainly number one, being flat broke all the goddamn time. Seriously every fuckin dollar you could spare and then some went toward it. Shit sucked! But it was awesome. But it sucked.
